value: Shotgun metagenomic sequencing of gut microbiome samples
Study population: Yanomami semi-nomadic hunter-gatherers from Brazil (n=15) and Venezuela (n=8), compared with Matses (n=24), Tunapuco (n=12), and US urban population (n=44)
Total sequencing reads: ~219 million reads, ~14 million reads per sample average
Non-host reads after filtering: ~198 million reads
Taxonomic classification performed using Kraken with NCBI whole genome database
Functional classification using SUPER-FOCUS based on SEED database gene families
Ethics approval: Oswaldo Cruz Foundation Ethics Research Committee No. 638/11 and CONEP No. 16907
uncurated_metadata.evidence_quote: shotgun metagenomic data; ~219 million reads, with an average of ~14 million reads per sample
